BBTTCC Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Human heritage: Denisovan.

“Humanity is the species that keeps walking even when the map says stop.”

Human (Denisovan). You are not a fantasy human. You are the rebooted inheritance of an older lineage resurfacing after Yesod’s fall — ancient adaptations, forgotten instincts, and survival strategies given room to matter again. You remember mountains that no longer exist. Gravity listens to you when you ask it to.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Human).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Movement. 30 feet walking.
  • Lineage Lean. Human does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Body in fiction and through Tier powers.

Human Core: Stubborn Spark

At character creation you gain Stubborn Spark (Adaptive, Tenacious, Lineage Memory) from the Human species root.

Denisovan Traits

  • Thin-Air Blood. You have advantage on Body checks against poison, environmental suffocation, and extreme altitude. You can hold your breath for 10 minutes.
  • Stone-Sense. You gain tremorsense 10 feet while standing on stone or packed earth. You know, without a check, when something heavier than a child is moving against that substrate within range.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / BBTTCC)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Body OP and +1 Logistics OP at campaign start.
  • Hex Synergy. In Mountain / High-Altitude / Stone-Founded hexes, your faction's long-distance travel and construction operations gain +2 on success checks.
  • Ancient Route. Once per Strategic Turn, your faction may ignore the first Logistics cost of crossing difficult or weather-hostile terrain. The route was walked before the world was this shape; you remember the older path.
